title: Axles and wheels
intro: This truck's layout has not been set yet. Choose the number of axles and spares, watch the drawing change, then save.
driveAxlesHint: The axles behind the front axle — 4 tires each
trailerAxlesHint: Set to zero for a truck with no trailer
singleTrailer: Trailer axles carry one tire per side
singleTrailerHint: Leave unticked when each side has two tires next to each other.
sparesHint: Number of spare slots on the truck
changeLater: You can change the layout later, as long as no tire is recorded on the truck.
created: Layout saved — now register the tires
rebuildAllowed: No tire is recorded on the truck, so you can delete the layout and make it again.
rebuildBlocked: The layout cannot change while tires are recorded on the truck (count: {{n}}). Every tire must be taken off, or its fitting cancelled, first.
rebuild: Delete the layout and start again
rebuildBody: The layout and all its wheel positions are deleted, and you choose the layout again. No tire is affected because none is fitted.
deleted: Layout deleted — choose the new one
